details:
I'm just tired of seeing hangout worlds abusing the Games tag simply because they put a deck of cards on the sideline of their, objectively speaking, primarily hang out focused world. It'd be like me putting a single avatar in my game world so I could say it's an avatar world when we all know, the majority of people are not going to the avatar category to find a world like that, with a single avatar.

Ideally, the solution would be to have more strict guidelines on the Game tag and just remove the worlds from this category. But I understand their reasoning of doing this. There is a large spotlight put on avatar world and game worlds, given that they have their own categories in the world browser. But hangout worlds don't, despite being also up there as one of the most popular genres of worlds visited. So they cheat the system a little, add a little pool table prefab to their world so they can throw on the Game tag and call it a day.

Just give them their own category so they'll use that instead. And also limit people to only using one of these categories (avatar, game, hangout), so they can't try to double dip. It'll incentivize them to use the appropriate tags because they'll probably get more traction for their hangout world in a hangout category than in a games category.

(Also, an Adventure category would be ideal as well, I feel like that'd be the last main category missing, for worlds that aren't games, or hangouts, or avatar catalogs, but are just places to explore)
title: Hangout World category to get rid of the slop in the Games category
